claim_checks.claim: Oceanfront sanctuary on one of Maui's most pristine beaches
claim_checks.note: The resort fronts Wailea Beach, which Dr. Beach ranked No. 4 in the US for 2026 (No. 2 in 2025, No. 3 in 2024).

claim_checks.claim: Ancient Hawaiian royalty once walked here
claim_checks.note: No source found. The resort is adding a Queen's Garden cultural sanctuary honouring Queen Lili'uokalani, but that does not support this claim.

claim_checks.claim: Whale watching right from your balcony
claim_checks.note: Humpbacks winter in Maui waters and most rooms face the ocean, but no source confirms sightings from rooms. Soften to 'often visible from shore in season'.

claim_checks.claim: Occupies 15 acres of the Wailea coastline
claim_checks.note: 15 oceanfront acres (also on the Hawaii Tourism Authority listing).

claim_checks.claim: Three cascading pools that seem to flow into the Pacific
claim_checks.note: Three saline pools: Fountain, Waterfall (with slide) and the adults-only Serenity infinity pool. 'Flow into the Pacific' fits only Serenity's infinity edge.

claim_checks.claim: Property built on lava rock formations that create natural tide pools
claim_checks.note: No fetched source mentions tide pools or lava-rock foundations.

claim_checks.claim: Wailea Beach consistently ranks among America's best beaches
claim_checks.note: It has been in Dr. Beach's top 10 in 2024, 2025 and 2026.

claim_checks.claim: Indigenous plant collection of over 100 native Hawaiian species
claim_checks.note: Sources mention only 'lush tropical gardens'. No species count found.
Broadly right. The sanctuary season is mid-November to May, with peak January to mid-March.

claim_checks.claim: Resort provides complimentary binoculars at the concierge desk
Nightly sunset conch-shell ceremony at Wailea Point
claim_checks.note: No source found. Wailea Point is a separate headland and condominium area, not part of the resort.

claim_checks.claim: Resort art collection featuring renowned Hawaiian artists
claim_checks.note: An art collection was added in the 2007 and 2014-16 renovations. The 'Hawaiian artists' detail was not verified.

claim_checks.claim: Snorkel at the 'protected' Wailea Beach where green sea turtles visit
claim_checks.note: Wailea Beach is a public beach that is good for snorkelling when calm. It is not a designated protected marine area, and turtle sightings were not verified.
Ferraro's, DUO, Spago (Wolfgang Puck) and, since February 2025, KOMO (Japanese).
The new Kai Holo Spa opened in July 2026, with an aquathermal circuit and longevity centre. Older spa descriptions are outdated.
Kids For All Seasons is complimentary, daily 9am-5pm, for ages 5 and up.

claim_checks.claim: Resort can feel crowded during peak seasons
claim_checks.note: Not directly sourced. A travel-agent report says a new pool-chair policy reassigns unoccupied chairs after an hour.

facts.text: 383 rooms and suites on 15 oceanfront acres. Opened 9 February 1990.
Eight-storey U-shaped building gives most rooms Pacific views. Kahului Airport (OGG) is about 25 minutes away.
Fronts Wailea Beach, ranked No. 4 on Dr. Beach's 2026 list of best US beaches (No. 2 in 2025).
facts.source_title: CNN - Dr. Beach top 10 US beaches 2026
Forbes Travel Guide - Four Seasons Resort Maui at Wailea

facts.text: Three saline pools, including the adults-only Serenity Pool, an infinity pool with a swim-up bar, underwater music and bubble loungers.
facts.source_title: Forbes Travel Guide - Four Seasons Resort Maui at Wailea

facts.text: Restaurants: Ferraro's (open-air coastal Italian), DUO (steak and seafood), Spago (Wolfgang Puck), plus the Lobby Lounge.
facts.source_title: One Mile at a Time - Four Seasons Maui review

facts.text: KOMO, a 50-seat Japanese restaurant with a 14-seat sushi bar under Chef Kiyokuni Ikeda, opened in February 2025 and serves dinner 5-9pm.
facts.source_title: Maui Now - Four Seasons unveils Komo

facts.text: Kai Holo Spa opened in July 2026. It has an aquathermal circuit (vitality pool, hot pool, cold plunge, steam, sensory shower, traditional and infrared saunas), a longevity centre and an infrared movement studio.
Kids For All Seasons is complimentary, daily 9am-5pm, for ages 5 and up. Children 4 and under eat free at Ferraro's, DUO, the Lobby Lounge and KOMO with a dining adult.
A redesigned 26-room Club Floor with private lounge opened in May 2026, designed by Meyer Davis, as part of a resort-wide transformation.
facts.source_title: Four Seasons Press Room - Club Floor

facts.text: Filming location for Season 1 of HBO's The White Lotus.
Humpback whale season in Maui waters runs mid-November to May, peaking January to mid-March.

considerations.text: Guest-room renovation began in March 2026 and is due to finish around mid-December 2026, so stays this autumn may coincide with construction work. Confirm room status when booking.
considerations.source_title: Mann Publications - Kai Holo Spa / resort transformation

considerations.text: A travel-agent report says the resort has introduced a resort fee (covering aquathermal spa access, outrigger canoeing and cultural programming), whereas it previously had none. Confirm with the hotel.
Wailea Beach is public by Hawaii law, and reaching it from rooms means walking through the lobby and pool areas.
considerations.source_title: Forbes Travel Guide - Four Seasons Resort Maui at Wailea

considerations.text: Entry-level rooms are Mountain View. Ocean views require Ocean View, Ocean Front or Prime categories.
considerations.source_title: The Luxury Editor - Four Seasons Resort Maui

considerations.text: The Serenity Pool is adults-only, so families use the Fountain and Waterfall pools.
considerations.source_title: Forbes Travel Guide - Four Seasons Resort Maui at Wailea

best_for: Families with children 5 and up: complimentary Kids For All Seasons, a waterfall pool with slide, and free meals for kids 4 and under.
Couples: the adults-only Serenity infinity pool, open-air Ferraro's and the new Kai Holo Spa.
Beach lovers: directly on Wailea Beach, a Dr. Beach top-5 US beach in 2024-2026.
Winter travellers who want to see humpback whales (mid-November to May, peak January to mid-March).
